title: Batman Forever
about: Batman takes on the Riddler and Two-Face while taking in a young circus acrobat named Dick Grayson.

with egg and sprinkle with salt.Bake at 220°C until deep brown.Serve warm with mustard.Two-Face beef and chicken slidersTwo-Face and his coin tossHow to make itAs written, serves 4Two sliders per plate: a beef and cheddar slider with pickles, and a crumbed chicken slider with slaw, decided by a coin toss.Shape 400g beef mince into 4 small patties and grill 2 minutes a side, adding cheddar for
